def main():
    n, t = map(int, input().split())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))

    rows = [0] * n
    cols = [0] * n
    diag1 = 0
    diag2 = 0

    for i, ai in enumerate(a):
        r = (ai - 1) // n
        c = (ai - 1) % n
        rows[r] += 1
        cols[c] += 1

        if r == c:
            diag1 += 1

        if r + c == n - 1:
            diag2 += 1

        if rows[r] == n or cols[c] == n or diag1 == n or diag2 == n:
